sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicants submitted that applicant no.1 and victim of the case i.e. daughter of the opposite party no.2 have performed their marriage and they are at present residing as husband and wife.
It is next submitted that father of the victim is having no objection if proceeding pending against the applicants is quashed as his daughter is residing with applicant no.1 as his wife.

He further submitted that both applicant no.1 and victim are ready to appear before the court below for verification of the compromise executed between them either on the date fixed by this Court or by the lower court.

Learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 also conceded to the fact that applicant no.1 and victim of this case have solemnized their marriage and are now residing as husband and wife and he has no objection if proceeding pending against applicant be quashed.
Per contra, learned A.G.A. though opposed the prayer but could not dispute the fact the applicant no.1 and victim are residing as husband and wife.
I have heard learned counsel for both the parties and perused the record.

Although the present case relates to the POCSO Act but as victim of the case who is now a major lady is at present residing with the applicant no.1 as his wife and in her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., she stated that she has performed marriage with applicant no.1 and wants to reside with applicant no.1, therefore, considering the peculiar circumstances, it is directed that applicant no.1 and opposite party no.2 and victim shall appear before the court below for verification of the compromise within two weeks from today.

If within two weeks from today, applicant no.1 opposite party no.2 and victim will appear before the court below and move an application for verification of their compromise, then court below shall verify the settlement/compromise alleged to have been executed between them, in accordance with law, and transmit its report to this Court.
List this case on 09.01.2023.
